fusions.name: Overhand Heave
fusions.desc: Hurls a stake at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 14 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach, and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Wrong End Round
fusions.desc: Swings the shaft butt-first in a full circle that deals 4 blunt damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Staked Pit
fusions.desc: Digs a staked pit at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, then deals 20 damage to the first enemy to come within 2 tiles and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Brute Heft
fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1.
